sampling: uniform in time: frame i (1-based) of a variant is shown at (i - 1) / fps seconds; ramps, the turn's speed curve and the landing are baked in. Reverse = the same frames from last to first.
first_frame: D0: identical to the door still at this size
last_frame: M0: identical to the 16:9 frame of base.png at this size

cut_version.rule: the version inside U5: skip the frames of segment 'turn' (a cut HD -> HDx); play_s is shorter by the turn

loading.before_the_press: the door image (frame 1 is the same picture) and segments door, door+walk, walk
loading.stream: segments turn, dolly, landing, hold: requested at once, in play order; the button waits until they are in, or until the measured rate puts their arrival before they are due with a 1.5x margin
loading.never: no frame is waited for during play: a late frame is skipped and counted

swap.rule: after the hold, a soft swap to the live layers of the empty room (the same picture)

note: S1 partial arrival 2026-11-17: door (code) + PLACEHOLDER for clip 1a (still, dissolve, still; labelled) + clip 1b (code) + turn (code) + clip 2 (take 1 + code repair r2). Not QA'd, not for the site.
placeholder_1a: bank 1's first piece (D0 -> HT) is a still placeholder, not clip 1a: the bytes of that part are not representative, and the frames are not for the site

phone_budget.rule: first load = the door image and the frames up to the turn; the rest of the frames and the living room's layers stream from the press, in play order (they are needed from the turn and from the landing)
